name: M5.FiniteExclusion.filtered_powerset
statement: ∀ (S : Finset M5.BinaryPolynomial) (bad : M5.BinaryPolynomial → Bool), S.powerset.filter (fun H => ∀ p ∈ H, bad p = true) = (S.filter (fun p => bad p = true)).powerset
guidance: Extensionality, Finset.mem_filter, mem_powerset and subset_iff. Both sides describe subsets contained in the bad factor set. Return only tactic lines without leading by; preserve exact target.
